scope: Targeted scoping review, not exhaustive systematic review
searched: arXiv, ACL Anthology, ACM via indexed records/official programs/author copies, publisher journals, CEUR, GoogleScholar attempted
access_limits: ACM direct search inaccessible; author institutional sources and full manuscripts used
No citation-count or significance inference without verification

records.title: OG-RAG
records.finding: Ontology-grounded hypergraph retrieval; authors report 55% context recall and40% response correctness improvement, not percentage points.
records.limitation: Generated QA/RAGAS evaluation; ontology grounding and retrieval algorithm change together; not same-rule Python/RDF isolation.

records.title: Ontology-to-tools compilation for executable semantic constraint enforcement in LLM agents
records.finding: 30 chemistry papers; synthesis-step F1 .843 full versus .572 without constraint feedback.
records.limitation: Strong adjacent positive evidence for executable feedback; not evidence of SHACL-specific benefit or superiority over matched Python tools.

records.title: I Cannot Read All That: concise ontology-agnostic building-specific schemas
records.finding: b-schema summarizes Brick/S223 models for queries, validation and LLM query generation; four HVAC questions show useful improvements.
records.limitation: Tiny QA evaluation; one S223 question still fails. Closely relevant to our schema/context bottleneck, not broad accuracy benchmark.

records.title: Evidence-Carrying Validation for Knowledge Graphs
records.finding: Shifty returns satisfaction traces and failure witnesses. Corpora45Brick+19S223 models; median materialization cost1.54-2.07x conformance-only.
records.limitation: Direct prior art for evidence-producing validators; not measured end-to-end LLM hallucination reduction.

records.title: OntoRipple: Making waves in the knowledge graph lifecycle
records.read_level: publisher abstract and author manuscript accessed
records.finding: Propagates ontology changes into RML mappings and SHACL shapes.
records.limitation: Direct lifecycle overlap; no verified human-labor effect size extracted. Do not claim all arbitrary code/prompts/agent state migrated.

records.title: NL2SHACL-Bench
records.finding: Natural-language requirements to SHACL; separates syntax, structure and semantic equivalence. Samples and logical containment expose different failures.
records.limitation: Logical checker has fragment/time coverage limits; author text has rate-denominator nuances, so no aggregate equivalence number quoted.

records.title: Systematic Evaluation of Knowledge Graph Repair with Large Language Models
records.finding: Violation-inducing operations create repair tasks; Brick,LUBM,QUDT; relevant concise constraint context improves repairs versus entire manifest.
records.limitation: Injected failures and supplied constraints, not natural corruption prevalence or factual truth. Repairs of interdependent violations not fully assessed.

records.title: SHACL Validation under Graph Updates
records.finding: Static analysis asks whether updates preserve constraints for every initially conforming graph; regression to satisfiability.
records.limitation: Not an incremental runtime speed benchmark. General problem and fragments have significant decidability/complexity limitations.

records.title: SHACL validation in the presence of ontologies: Semantics and rewriting techniques
records.finding: Core-universal-model semantics integrates open-world ontology reasoning with constraint validation and reduces to ordinary validation through rewriting.
records.limitation: Formal contribution, no empirical LLM accuracy dataset. Ordinary pySHACL validation does not automatically implement all this semantics.

records.title: OntoRAG: Enhancing Question-Answering through Automated Ontology Derivation from Unstructured Knowledge Bases
records.finding: Clusters extracted entities and builds ontology hierarchy; reports comprehensiveness win rates85% versus vector RAG and75% versus best GraphRAG configuration.
records.limitation: Comprehensiveness preference is not factual accuracy; multiple extraction/chunking/retrieval components differ.

records.title: Ontology Learning and Knowledge Graph Construction: A Comparison of Approaches and Their Impact on RAG Performance
records.finding: One grant application,20manualquestions. GraphRAG and both chunk-enriched ontology variants each18/20correct.
records.limitation: Evidence against unconditional superiority; preserving textual chunks matters. Small single-document study.

records.title: OntoURL
records.finding: 15tasks,57303questions,40ontologies,8domains,20models in this version; ontology understanding/reasoning/learning distinct.
records.limitation: Do not mix later journal counts36159/43 from December2026 issue with selected version. Benchmark measures LLM ontology ability, not RDF-system advantage.

records.title: Large Language Models Assisting Ontology Evaluation
records.finding: OE-Assist uses1393competencyquestions with ontologies and stories; automated CQ verification compared with manualgold and users.
records.limitation: CQ coverage/evaluation useful for selecting needed semantics; not assurance of all downstream task correctness.

records.title: Evo-DKD: Dual-Knowledge Decoding for Autonomous Ontology Evolution in Large Language Models
records.finding: Proposes ontology edits with textual justification and validation loop.
records.limitation: Authors explicitly simulate dual-decoder behavior with prompts dueGPUconstraints. Treat as exploratory, not verified implemented dual-decoder architecture.

records.title: Large Language Models for Ontology Engineering: A Systematic Literature Review
records.finding: Published review selects36papers49task-levelstudies, search throughMay2025. Maintenance sparse within that sample.
records.limitation: Not survey coverage throughOctober2026; repository earlier counts34/46 differ, use published version. Does not prove maintenance field globally empty.

records.title: Lessons Learned from the Combined Development of OWL and SHACL
records.read_level: author institution abstract and official conference program
records.finding: Railway case combines OWL,SHACL,SKOS; engine feature differences and manual effort remain; coordinated model/shape change management.
records.limitation: Experience paper, not controlled maintenance-labor comparison. Institution January1date is not exact conference date; officialprogram December10-12.

records.title: Ontology Evolution in Invasion Biology Using Large Language Models: A Hybrid Approach
records.finding: Hybrid LLM approach updates existing INBIO ontology with emerging scientific knowledge.
records.limitation: Concrete evolution domain candidate; quantitative effectiveness not verified in this pass.

synthesis.revise: Same-rule deterministic parity does not test retrieval grounding, schema compression, action-space constraints, ontology evolution or schema induction. Prior local findings cannot generalize to ontology uselessness.
synthesis.retain: No evidence here establishes universal RDF/SHACL superiority over a competent same-semantics implementation; factual truth is not validation conformance.
synthesis.candidate_question: Can task-specific semantic context and evidence-carrying feedback help an LLM execute and adapt queries/tools under schema changes at equal cost, without increasing unnecessary withholding? Novelty not established.
candidate_design: same actual domain source and frozen natural-language questions
compare full schema versus task-specific schema summary
compare boolean report versus evidence-carrying feedback
separate interpretation, query, retrieval, evidence, final-answer and update errors
include changes, incomplete evidence, wrong mapping, costs and failed runs
